title: Paris café fashion reel
text: A golden-hour café street scene for a coat, a quilted bag and a coffee-to-go lifestyle look
idea: A lifestyle reel that sells a feeling first: a European street at sunset, a camel coat and a quilted bag on the café table.
why: Golden-hour light makes the product colours rich.
Lifestyle context shows how the pieces are worn.
Works for fashion, accessories and coffee brands alike.
